mentions.name: instantrows
mentions.description: Browser-based, no-download tool for working with data exports: drop in CSV, JSON, Excel, or Parquet files, join them together, run quick aggregations, and share the results via a live link without needing a data engineer or a data warehouse.
mentions.problem: Joining and sharing csv/json/excel/parquet exports is painful: Excel breaks, BI tools are overkill, and emailing final_v2.csv around is a nightmare.
mentions.audience: People who regularly deal with data exports and need results without a data engineer or warehouse.
mentions.source_excerpt: i’m working on instantrows, basically trying to kill the pain of dealing with csv/json/excel/parquet exports when all you really want is to join them together, do some quick aggregations, and share the result without begging a data engineer or spinning up a whole warehouse.

evidence.value: i’m working on instantrows, basically trying to kill the pain of dealing with csv/json/excel/parquet exports when all you really want is to join them together, do some quick aggregations, and share the result without begging a data engineer or spinning up a whole warehouse.
